posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
OK, PW AA is not needed.

I had Dark Visionary, Santa Guise, Super Scientific Tachyon and Tempest in that order fighting Ambuscade in Wagner Mars Base.

The other three heroes abused rewind mechanics to setup Tempest with his 7 Ongoings and 3 Lightning One-Shots in hand.

Ambuscade means no Ongoing Destruction and Wagner Mars Base means you can set up while protected by a Meteor Storm.

 

The three one-shots were played on different, but subsequent turns, with Ball Lightning last.  None of the three were played prior to him getting his Ongoings in play.  In fact, the only other thing Tempest played was an Aquatic Correspondance via Santa Guise's flip Power.

 

So I think it's something as simple as having a certain set of cards in play.  Perhaps not all 7 Ongoings are needed, but we can certainly try:

Tempest plays Lightning Slash, Ball Lightning and Chain Lightning while he has all 7 of his Ongoing cards in play.

If it's not that, it's a subset, as team, Villain and Environment do not seem to matter.
